semantic.justification: The original packed error code retains area, class and low code, independent warning bit, unsigned projection and the code-only message behavior used by file filters. Native source-location and dialog argument overloads are outside this code-only slice. Native file-error continuation adds every original ERRCODE_IO packed macro and SVSTREAM alias, validated directly against the pinned header and through native file diagnostics/SvStream warning and first-error behavior. No diagnostic numeric value, warning mask, formatter or source-location/dialog profile is changed.
